artworks.title: Woman Whipping a Satyr
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical procession featuring various mythical creatures and figures. The scene is populated by a variety of figures adorned in flowing garments, interacting with an array of fantastical creatures. Some figures carry baskets or garlands. The scene is detailed with intricate lines and swirling forms. The background also includes foliage.

artworks.title: Satyr Driving a Pair of Goats
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures with goats in a pastoral setting. The drawing shows figures interacting with goats. The central figure appears to be food-laden, with garlands. Other figures guide or ride the goats. The composition has a sense of movement. In the background, there is a large tree with figures seated underneath. The etching style features fine lines and detailed shading.

artworks.title: Drunken Silenus
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is an etching of a bucolic scene featuring mythological figures and animals. The drawing portrays a variety of characters reminiscent of classical mythology, including figures with goat-like features and satyr characteristics. In the foreground, an animal resembling a goat or deer is prominent, interacting with the statue of a figure with similar features. Different figures appear engaged in activities like carrying what seem to be clusters of grapes. The scene is rich with naturalistic elements, including trees and foliage winding around the figures. The arrangement of figures and their dynamic poses suggest a lively and festive atmosphere, typical of classic mythological illustrations.

artworks.title: Satyrs and Putti Playing with Animals
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene featuring mythical creatures and animals. The scene depicts a group interaction within a lush environment full of trees and foliage. In the foreground are goat-like creatures seated among plants. Above and around these creatures, forms resembling cherubs can be seen playing and reaching out towards each other. The background features statuesque forms and figures engaged in activities, adding classical mythological themes. The drawing emphasizes intricate details and textures, capturing a vibrant view of nature and fantasy elements.

artworks.title: Putti and Satyrs Shooting Arrows
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This drawing features cherubic figures engaged in various playful activities in a mythical landscape. The scene depicts young winged figures involved in a variety of actions. On the left side, a cluster of cherubs surround a large muscular figure holding a sickle. In the center right, one figure rides a goat-like creature while another accompanies them. The background is filled with lush vegetation, and a water feature with a seated figure statue is visible. The right side shows more figures playing around a lion-like beast. The figures are depicted in an animated style, creating an energetic and whimsical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Satyr and Mercury Shooting at a Statue
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical creatures in a detailed scene. The artwork features a group of mythical figures, including satyrs and cherubs, in a natural setting. The figures are depicted in dynamic poses, interacting with one another and their surroundings. The scene is filled with swirling foliage and playful cherubs, creating a lively atmosphere. The composition is horizontal, emphasizing continuity and interaction. The artwork is created using fine lines and detailed etching techniques to render textures and forms.

artworks.title: A Misty Morning at Norwich
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a low vantage point over a body of water. The horizon is visible beyond a barge in the center of the composition. Two figures are guiding the barge, which is moving away. Trees with dappled shadows are on the left, and architectural structures are in the distance. The image is in sepia tone, with shades of brown and beige. Reflections of the barge and buildings are visible in the water.

artworks.title: The Moonlit River
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a water body with a dirt path running alongside it, leading to a white building in the distance. Trees are silhouetted against the sky, reflecting in the water. The horizon is low and the sky is expansive. The scene has a monochromatic color palette with varying shades of gray. Leaning trees are visible close by, adding scale, and the image has a soft, dreamy quality.

artworks.title: Buckenham Ferry
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a river scene from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The still water reflects tree silhouettes and boats. The horizon is low in the image, with tall trees on the left casting shadows against the light sky. In the distance, mist softens the transition from water to land, where a row of trees and a distant windmill are visible. The composition features monochromatic gray tones, creating a calm and serene atmosphere. Subtle reflections on the water enhance the tranquility. The image has a painterly quality with soft edges and gentle tonal transitions, evoking early morning or late evening light.

artworks.title: Children of the Broad
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a small boat on a body of water.

artworks.title: At the Ferry–A Misty Morning
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a horse-drawn cart as the central focus. The cart is slightly to the right, carrying four large milk containers. A driver is seated on the cart, partly obscured by mist. A figure is visible to the left, with their task partially hidden by fog. The horizon is unclear due to mist, enhancing depth. The photo uses a monochromatic color palette, with various shades of gray and black. The textures include grain in the photo and wooden details of the cart. A tree on the right adds texture through its foliage.

artworks.title: A Frosty Morning
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a horse-drawn cart carrying what seems to be hay or crops. A man walks alongside the horse, while another figure sits on the cart. In the background, cows graze in a misty field. The photo has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage feel. The grass texture is detailed, and the overall image is slightly blurred, enhancing the atmospheric quality of the scene.

artworks.title: The Snowy Marshlands
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image is a winter landscape captured from a level point of view. The horizon is about one-third from the bottom of the image and shows snow-covered fields with buildings, including houses with sloping roofs and chimneys in the distance. A line of trees stretches across the horizon, with a prominent leafless tree on the right side. Closest to the viewer is an irregular wooden fence partially buried in snow. The image has a soft focus and a monochromatic color palette dominated by whites, grays, and browns.

artworks.title: A Frosty Morning at Coltishall
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with a bridge, a horse-drawn cart crossing the bridge in the distance, and the reflection of the scene in the water. Surrounding the canal are leafless shrubs, and the sky is visible above. The image has a grainy texture and a color palette of muted grays, blacks, and whites.

artworks.title: The Village by the River
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river running through it. The viewpoint is at eye level. In the background, there are small buildings and trees along the horizon. On the right side of the riverbank, there is a group of leafless trees with their reflections in the water. The image is in black and white, with a soft focus and smooth tones. The sky is light and overcast, blending with the water's reflection.

artworks.title: The Edge of the Broad
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a water channel running diagonally from the bottom right towards the distance. A rustic house with a thatched roof is seen on the right side among trees. The sky is lightly clouded. Trees, some bare with leafless branches, are spread across marshy ground with reflections in the water. The color palette is monochromatic with muted tones of grey and brown, creating a serene atmosphere. Textures in the grass and water are visible in the photograph.

artworks.title: Marsh Farm in Early Spring
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a plowed field with a person operating a horse-drawn plow in the center. In the background, there are thatched barns and structures along the horizon, with bare trees against a lightly clouded sky. The photograph is in black and white, emphasizing the texture of the soil and the aged feel of the rural buildings.

artworks.title: Sheep on the Marshes [Landscape with Cattle]
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil rural landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is obscured by dense mist, and silhouetted bare trees are faintly visible against the hazy sky. A gentle river winds through the scene, bordered by grassy areas where cattle graze. The texture is smooth with a subtle graininess, and the palette is sepia-toned, giving the picture a warm, muted appearance. The mist diffuses the light, creating a soft atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Marshes in June
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape viewed from ground level. The horizon is low, with a vast open sky dominating the upper portion of the image. In the foreground, two figures are on a grassy field, one facing away and blurred, the other smaller and off to the left. Beyond them, a group of sheep is scattered, creating gentle arcs with their woolly shapes. The color palette is sepia tones, giving the scene a warm feel. The overall impression conveys tranquility and openness, emphasized by the expansive sky and earthy hues of the field.

artworks.title: A Daughter of the Marshland
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and face of a person facing the camera. The person is wearing an ornate hat with large feathers and fabric details, and a dark, textured fabric that covers their shoulders and chest. Their facial features include a subtle smile, dark eyes, and eyebrows. The background is a plain, blurred space, giving the photograph an aged, sepia-toned appearance.

artworks.title: Marshes by the North Sea
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wide expanse of land where several sheep are grazing. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, with sparse trees and buildings in the distance. The overall color palette consists of brown and sepia tones, giving the scene a muted and nostalgic feel. The ground texture appears dry, emphasizing the rustic environment.

artworks.title: Madame Arlon Spinning Silk
artworks.medium: engraving with etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 39 × 26.5 cm (15 3/8 × 10 7/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Katharine Shepard Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in a chair, facing forward with a calm expression. She has soft features, arched eyebrows, and styled hair with a hat. She wears a dress with ruffled sleeves and a scarf. The woman holds a spinning wheel, operating it gently. The background is a dark patterned canvas with text below the image.

artworks.title: An Arab Rider on Camelback
artworks.medium: black chalk with white heightening on blue paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person in profile, body slightly turned towards the viewer. The upper three-quarters of the body is depicted, with one arm raised slightly. The person's face is obscured by a hood, and the head is covered by fabric of a large cloak or robe. The person wears layered, draped clothing with intricate details. The drawing is against a blue-toned background, with no visible jewelry or objects held by the person.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Traveler Resting
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with a figure under trees in the foreground. In the mid-distance, there is a large building on a hill. The engraving is detailed with precise linework depicting foliage, rocks, and water. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow. Hills, trees, and clouds are visible in the distance.
